title: Raise a car's tilt steering wheel 6 degrees on its stepless clamp column: free the lock lever, carry the wheel, clamp it
instruction: Pull the lock lever under the steering column down, raise the wheel 6 degrees, push the lever back up to lock it, and let go of the wheel and lever.
context: Every driver who shares a car resets the wheel before driving, and fleet, bus and truck drivers do it at the start of each shift: 240 million licensed US drivers (FHWA Highway Statistics 2024) and about 2.2 million US heavy and tractor-trailer truck drivers (BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook; many heavy-truck columns tilt by an air valve, so an upper bound). Honda's shop manual for the 2019-2022 Insight steering column gives its forces: a tilt and telescopic column held by a lock lever, a lock lever force of 82 N max measured 10 mm in from the lever end, and a tilting force of 69 N max up or down with the lever loose. Owner's manuals for lever-lock columns give the steps: pull the lever down, set the wheel, push the lever up to lock it.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left; heights above the bench top. (1) A dashboard block, x 56 to 70, y -35 to 35, 36 high, fixed. (2) A tilt steering column hinged inside it at x 58.9, height 21.8, rising toward the robot at 23 degrees from horizontal, 3 kg moving mass with its wheel, tilting 0 to 13 degrees, stepless: a friction clamp, as on the Honda Insight 2019-2022 column (part 53200-TBA-A02), holds it at any angle when the lever is shut. It starts clamped at 0. With the lever open the column is free: gravity and its tilt spring leave a net torque at the target of 1.2 N m downward (it droops) in the default scene; the range runs use 3.0 N m down and 5.9 N m up (it springs up). (3) A 370 mm steering wheel (25 mm rim, three spokes: left, right, down) on the column, its centre at x 35, y 0, height 32. (4) The lock lever under the column on the robot's left: a 68 mm arm and a 25 x 25 x 10 mm handle 10.5 cm along the column from its hinge, at y 8.5. It swings down 25 degrees to open, stays where it is left (15 N at the handle moves it either way, the real trial's adjusted setting; Honda's service setting is up to 82 N), frees the column past 10 degrees down and clamps it within 3 degrees of its stop. (5) A yellow tape mark on the dashboard face at the rim-top height of the 6-degree target. A real build: a used Honda Insight 2019-2022 column with its wheel (about $36 used), bolted to a bench frame at 23 degrees.
scoring: Judged on the state at the end; only failures latch (the void, or a lock that moves under the test push). Locked at the target (0.5): the column clamped at 6 +/- 1 degrees above its start, the lever within 3 degrees of its stop, and a lattice of points 2 to 3 cm apart over each gripper (fingertips, pads, palm, housing) at least 3 cm from the wheel, column and lever, held 1 s. Done (1.0): then a 5 N push down the arc at the rim top moves the column less than 1 degree over 0.5 s. Void (0): the column moved more than 1.5 degrees in the 0.5 s before the clamp closed (a dropped or swung wheel). Real trial: a digital angle gauge (0.1 degree) on the column shroud reads 6 +/- 1 degrees above the start reading; hands clear is judged from the end video, the void from rim-top travel over 8 mm against a ruler in the side video; the push is a 5 N spring scale at the rim top.
run_limit: 1,200 steps (60 s at 20 Hz); the scripted demo reaches 1.0 at step 587 (29.35 s) on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER.
reset_notes: About 20 s, nothing consumed: pull the lever down, lower the wheel by the rim to its lowest stop, push the lever up and check the wheel will not move. No hidden variables; no seed changes the scene.
fidelity: Wheel and column at typical car size; lever and position follow the Honda Insight 2019-2022 shop manual (69 N tilt max). Lever force 15 N at the trial's adjusted setting (Honda's service setting up to 82 N; simulation runs pass 15 to 82 N). Unlocked net torque is bound by gravity's 5.9 N m; runs pass 3.0 N m down to 5.9 N m up. Estimates: column angle, 3 kg mass, 13 degree travel, lever handle and angles, hinge damping; each range-run and measured in the real trial.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0 (1 trial, 1,200 steps, session held); demo: 1.0
